title: Provision an AWS VPC with Terraform
title_es: Provisionar una VPC de AWS con Terraform
description: Complete Terraform configuration for a production-ready AWS VPC: public and private subnets across three AZs, NAT gateways, route tables, security groups, flow logs and VPC endpoints.
description_es: Configuración Terraform completa para una VPC de AWS lista para producción: subredes públicas y privadas en tres AZs, NAT gateways, tablas de ruteo, security groups, flow logs y VPC endpoints.
